result.topic_en: Gauss computes a correction term W for case III (y whole, [x] even) and assembles the total 'Decrement' from cases I–IV plus Q+S+W, followed by a sign table for ¼(Q+S+W) according to the signs of a,b, A,B and α,β, in connection with biquadratic residues.

methods.what: Expression of the case-III sum (all terms minus four times the specially marked ones) as a difference of 'Intensors', defining the correction W
methods.quote:
III. $\Sigma\varepsilon$ von allen
$-4\Sigma\varepsilon$ der besondern $\Big\}$ = Intensor$(\frac{1}{2}-\omega)m$ − Intens. $\omega m$[?]
$= -W$

methods.what: Table of values of W according to the signs of a,b and the parity of (m−1)/2
Total decrement as the sum of contributions from cases I–IV plus correction terms Q+S+W
